title: Influence bound for bounded-size circuits
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $d,s$ be natural numbers. If $f$ is computed by a depth-$d$ circuit of size at most $s$ for some width, then its total influence is at most $4\bigl(20(\lceil\log_2(s+1)\rceil+2)\bigr)^{d-1}$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
Existence of a depth-$d$, size-at-most-$s$ circuit for the function, with some width
